description: Reproducibility config for python-network-anomaly-detector. Records the seeds, split definitions, and dataset preparation parameters behind every reported number.
feature_scope: Feature selection excludes any column named in detector.LIKELY_LABEL_COLUMNS (label, attack, attack_cat, class, target, is_anomaly, ground_truth, y, is_attack).

cic_ids2017_subset_with_day.csv.note: Balanced 6000 benign / 6000 attack; day + attack-type preserved.

active_learning.balancing: class_weight='balanced' in base LogisticRegression; folds are StratifiedKFold with random_state from --random-state.
active_learning.note: margin and entropy are collapsed into the single posterior-uncertainty strategy: for a binary logistic-regression posterior they rank rows identically to uncertainty.

active_learning_stats.test: paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank + paired t-test on per-seed F1; Bonferroni-corrected across number of alternative strategies

strict_generalization.family_mode_test_pool: held-out family attacks + a 20% benign test split
strict_generalization.day_mode_test_pool: the ENTIRE held-out day (both benign and attack flows); no held-out-day row appears in training
strict_generalization.note: day mode is a true temporal hold-out (reviewer-corrected): benign is not split across days.

imbalance_eval.note: threshold for recall@FPR is selected on an inner validation split of each training fold, then applied once to the untouched test fold (reviewer-corrected).

cross_dataset.note: Uses shared feature-name intersection; UNSW/CIC share zero names, CIC-IDS2017/CSE-CIC-IDS2018 share 27.
